shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' .lore/dod.md 2>/dev/null || true
printf '\\n--- spec files ---\\n'
rg --files | rg '("'^|/)(specs|'"\\.specify|.*test.*|package\\.json)' | head -200
printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'
sed -n '1,220p' package.json
printf '\\n--- registry ---\\n'
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
printf '\\n--- relevant spec ---\\n'
if [ -f specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md; fi
printf '\\n--- specify spec matches ---\\n'
rg -n -C 2 'tool|schema|validation|inputSchema' .specify/spec.md | head -240"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- status ---'; git status --short; printf '%s\\n' '--- test examples ---'; sed -n '1,220p' src/providers/providerFactory.test.ts; sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- types ---'; sed -n '1,240p' src/types/ai.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- logger ---'; sed -n '1,240p' src/shared/logger.ts; printf '%s\\n' '--- jest config ---'; rg --files -g '*jest*' -g 'tsconfig*.json' -g '.lore/test-commands.yml' | xargs -r -n1 sh -c 'echo --- "'$0; sed -n "1,220p" "$0"'"'; printf '%s\\n' '--- spec-link conventions ---'; rg -n -C 2 'validated by|spec:' src scripts specs .lore 2>/dev/null | head -240"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; printf '\\n--- test command config ---\\n'; if [ -f .lore/test-commands.yml ]; then sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml; else echo missing; fi; printf '\\n--- AGENTS ---\\n'; sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null || true; printf '\\n--- all existing specs headings/status ---\\n'; for f in specs/*/spec.md; do echo \"--- "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,18p' \""'$f"; done | head -160'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check; printf '%s\\n' '--- changed files ---'; git status --short; printf '%s\\n' '--- test declarations ---'; nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,150p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- spec ---'; nl -ba specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- dod ---'; sed -n '1,220p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "test(tools): define input validation acceptance" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
